assets.visualReview: Inspected individually on paper and black backgrounds; no people, human hands, human faces or branding
assets.prompt: Create ONE educational illustration, a separate cutout asset. Fine charcoal ink contours with restrained layered watercolour and realistic object/anatomy proportions. Match an editorial natural-history teaching collection. TRUE transparent alpha outside the object, no painted paper rectangle, no checkerboard. Keep roughly 12% clear transparent margins on every side. No people, human hands, human faces, text, numbers, brands, arrows or labels. Animal heads are essential where appropriate. Preserve the requested view and approximate aspect ratio. No cast shadow or floor unless explicitly requested. ASSET BRIEF: Two potato cylinders from the same potato: one straight and firm, the other visibly bowed and limp. Same original cut dimensions and natural pale tissue colour, separated side by side, no labels or arrows. Transparent background.

qualification: Plate inspection only. No design edits, speech, renders or lesson approval.
